subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Last note from me on the funded-account program for {Brand}, after my earlier email on closing the registered-to-funded gap and the CAC band note. If funded-account quality and incrementality are on your roadmap this quarter, I can share the KYC-pass read by source and a short holdout view this week. If the timing is not right, I will leave it here and step back. Either way you have the context for when it is useful.
register_notes: Stage 3 EN Nigeria neobank native English: references original outreach and both earlier stages in first sentences; direct close with easy out (releases the prospect if timing is wrong); no figure; zero question marks; no sign-off; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y'.
